slides.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin just sat down together for historic talks
slides.subline: **Three-way talks in Shenzhen on Nov. 19.** Nuclear arms, Ukraine and Iran were on the table.

slides.body: At the APEC summit in **Shenzhen, China**, Trump met Putin for about **40 minutes**, then held talks with Xi. After that, all [[three leaders]] sat down together. It capped Trump's three-day Asia trip.
The agenda: [[nuclear arms control]], the wars in **Ukraine** and **Iran**, and trade. Xi called the talks **"positive, constructive and fruitful"**. Putin said they were **"open and candid"**.

Expectations were low. The joint statements did not address **Taiwan** or **Ukraine**, and Kyiv and its European allies worry they could be [[left out]]. Can three rival powers really end wars? Tell us below.
